subject_seen: a chubby cat silhouette sitting upright with a raised paw and curved tail
summary: The cat is clearly readable and charmingly round, but it reads as a sitting cat waving, not a dancing kitten — the rhythmic hip-sway and standing energy the piece promised are missing, so I wouldn't sign it yet.
next_intent: Make the kitten unambiguously dancing: standing tall on hind legs with an exaggerated side-to-side hip sway and both paws pumping in the air.
next_wan_prompt: High-contrast 1bpp silhouette animation, pure white graphic figure of a chubby kitten against a total black void. The kitten stands fully upright on its hind legs, torso tall and vertical, both front paws thrust high and pumping alternately, hips swinging in wide exaggerated arcs side to side, tail whipping low in counter-rhythm. Round belly, big head, thick bold masses, no interior detail, crisp cut-paper edges. Motion is big and comedic: two counts left, two counts right, an obvious hop with feet leaving ground every fourth beat, ears flicking on the off-beat. Static camera, centered composition, flat shadow-play style, seamless loop.
